Independent projects

Three browser experiments. Open one and try it.

TERRA

Procedural planet explorer

Generate a world from a seed, then fly from orbit down to its terrain. Shared links reproduce the same planet.

How it works

Terrain streams through Web Workers as a quadtree of patches. Rivers, towns, weather, and seasons come from deterministic generation. Custom shaders handle clouds, oceans, ice, and lava.

Open projectSource

CONSTRUCT

Liquid sculpture studio

Pull, split, merge, and freeze liquid into sculptures. Try four materials, save your work, or export a 4K image.

How it works

WebGPU compute simulates particles. A density field turns them into a continuous surface. Frozen regions keep exact anchors while the rest of the liquid moves.

Open project

PELAGIC

Interactive ocean life

Meet a bioluminescent jellyfish, then explore a living aquarium. Add fish, rays, plants, and rocks; drop food and watch the school respond.

How it works

Fixed-step simulations drive tentacles, schooling, feeding, and obstacle avoidance. Instanced fish, procedural anatomy, and translucent shaders run in WebGL with adaptive resolution.
